summary: Phase 3 (Sales) end-to-end verification. Backend pytest: 14/14 PASS (phase3_test.py) covering enriched lead detail, idempotent customer-from-lead, inspections, estimate server-side totals (subtotal=6200, tax=511.50, total=6711.50, EST-xxxx), Idempotency-Key on estimates, optimistic If-Match=999 -> 409, quote-from-estimate with copied items + QUO-xxxx + total match, idempotent /accept returning same job_id + JOB-xxxx + total match, edit-locked-on-accepted -> 400, invoice-from-quote (INV-xxxx, job_id linked, items copied, total match), invoice status transition to paid, RBAC (sales can POST /customers + /estimates; sales gets 403 on POST /invoices, /quotes/{id}/accept, /territories, and GET /invoices), and audit trail contains estimate.create/customer.create/quote.accept/invoice.create. Regression: 36/36 backend tests (phase1 + phase2) still PASS. Frontend Playwright: owner workflow on seeded lead — create-customer -> add-inspection -> new-estimate (2 line items @ 8.25% tax, client displays $6,711.50 which matches server) -> generate-quote -> send-quote -> accept-quote (accept-dialog + confirm) -> job appears in Jobs section -> create-invoice -> invoice appears in Invoices section. /jobs page (jobs-table with 2 rows including new job). /finance shows Quotes tab (2 quotes) + Invoices tab (2 invoices) + invoice-status-{id} -> paid succeeds. /customers lists 5 customers including 'TEST_UI_P3_Lead'; Add-customer dialog creates a new customer. RBAC UI as sales user: on lead detail — accept-quote-* buttons hidden (0), create-invoice-* buttons hidden (0), section-invoices hidden; /finance tab-invoices hidden, tab-quotes visible. Everything green.
critical_code_review_comments: quotes.py PUT /api/quotes/{id}: when only tax_rate is updated (no items), compute_totals is called with QuoteLineItem ORM rows — this works via duck-typing (quantity/unit_price attrs exist) but is fragile; consider fetching as LineItemIn or explicit tuples.

invoices.py create_invoice does not check quote status before copying — an invoice can currently be created from a 'draft' or 'declined' quote. Business rule likely requires status=='accepted'. Consider guarding this on the server (owner/admin path).

quotes.py accept_quote is idempotent for job creation (unique quote_id) but a repeat call still updates accepted_at/accepted_by/acceptance_name on the quote when status='accepted' branch is not first-checked. The current code path returns early before those mutations, but any refactor should preserve that guard.
invoices.py set_status has no state-machine (draft -> issued -> paid -> void). A voided invoice can still be flipped back to 'paid'. Acceptable for records-only tracking but note for compliance.
estimate & invoice idempotency key rows never expire — IdempotencyKey table will grow unbounded. Add a TTL sweep job.

LeadDetail.jsx onclick handlers do not disable buttons during in-flight calls (only setBusy on some), so rapid double-clicks on generate-quote / send-quote could produce duplicate quotes. Backend has no dedup for quotes.
Backend has no server-side check that the invoice's quote is 'accepted' — a sales role would 403 anyway, but an office/admin could create an invoice from a draft quote.
